data.description: Poor Customer Service and Failure to Meet Delivery Dates
data.content:
* * *

## [Poor Customer Service and Failure to Meet Delivery Dates](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4bc069732de8a710fcc9fc)

I was told my bed would ship within 3-5 weeks. I was given multiple expected ship dates, none of which were met. I received no explanation and currently have no ETA. Further, I ordered this item in May so that it would arrive in a window of time that I would be home. We are now expecting to travel and I have no updates when my item will arrive. I will likely have to arrange a white glove delivery while I am out of the country.

It is unlikely I will order another big ticket item from Lulu and Georgia because the communication is atrocious and I have multiple unmet expectations.

July 5, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 7, 2026

We're sorry to hear about your experience and understand your frustration with the delays and lack of communication. This is not the experience we want for our customers. A member of our team will be reaching out to review your order and provide further assistance. We appreciate your feedback and the opportunity to help resolve this matter.

Lulu and Georgia
